description_ru: Голоцен. Аллювиальные отложения русел рек и низкой поймы. Галечники с валунами, гравийники, пески, супеси, суглинки, илы, глины, торф (13 м)
note: GGK-200/2 N-51-XVI, Stanovaya series, Quaternary map, 2nd edition (compiled FGUGP Amurgeologiya, author S.N. Belikov, editor V.V. Kolesnikov; approved NRS MPR RF 21 Nov 2000; signed to print 28 Dec 2004 at the VSEGEI cartographic factory, (c) Rosnedra 2004), frame 123-124E, 54-54d40mN; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2409 px PREVIEW (~35 m/px); tints calibrated on the map from the legend swatches (preview_tint_calib.py, drift 1.6-9.8 dE), pH and pEII? pinned to their swatches, thinned 2 px with --class-dE 6 (otherwise they grow along every valley edge); same-tint group merged: aH+a1III (F, 39-46 % ambiguous); peat cover (green hatch) not extracted; pre-Quaternary formations only on the correlation scheme; frame = 4 corners on the frame-line centre (ridge filter) + 9 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings + 11 frame ticks ; same printed colour as a1III: one class
